items.title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
items.content: Jensen Huang’s leather jacket, traders busting out fax machines during the Outlook outage, mega paydays for AI talent, and first-class Frontier tickets for $129: Join Lisa Mateo, David Gura and Christina Ruffini for a roundup of headlines you may have missed, but gotta see. (Source: Bloomberg)

(Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 《顺便说说：你可能错过的头条新闻》一文回顾了几个关键事件：英伟达CEO黄仁勋的皮夹克、Outlook系统故障时交易员使用传真机、人工智能人才获得高额薪酬，以及129美元的Frontier头等舱机票。文章由Lisa Mateo、David Gura和Christina Ruffini主持，摘录了读者可能忽略但值得关注的新动态。（信息来源：彭博社）

It recommends a Bloomberg roundup hosted by Lisa Mateo, David Gura, and Christina Ruffini for more updates.

items.title: AI Tools Huang Championed Now Star in Memes of His Downfall
items.content: Once artificial intelligence’s leading hype-man, Jensen Huang is now the face of an AI-driven meme craze.
items.contentSnippet: Once artificial intelligence’s leading hype-man, Jensen Huang is now the face of an AI-driven meme craze.
items.creator: Elena Eisenstadt

summaries.zh: 黄仁勋曾作为人工智能的领军人物备受追捧，如今却因AI技术引发的负面事件成为网络迷因（meme）的主角。
summaries.en: Jensen Huang, once a prominent advocate for AI, is now featured in memes reflecting his downfall. His image has become central to an AI-driven meme trend, marking a shift in public perception.

items.title: Anthropic IPO Tests Investor Appetite for AI
items.content: Bloomberg Technology co-host Ed Ludlow tells Bloomberg This Weekend why Anthropic’s upcoming IPO could be a major test of investor appetite for AI, with the offering heavily oversubscribed and poised to follow SpaceX’s blockbuster debut. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ludlow also explains how Nvidia and Jensen Huang’s departure loom over the offering, given Nvidia’s planned investment in Anthropic and Huang’s central role connecting the companies powering the AI boom. (Source: Bloomberg)

Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ludlow also explains how Nvidia and Jensen Huang’s departure loom over the offering, given Nvidia’s planned investment in Anthropic and Huang’s central role connecting the companies powering the AI boom. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: Anthropic即将进行的IPO可能成为投资者对AI兴趣的重要测试，其认购量远超预期，有望复制SpaceX的成功。但Nvidia原计划对Anthropic的投资以及创始人黄仁勋在连接AI领域关键公司中的核心作用，目前对其IPO构成潜在影响。
summaries.en: Anthropic's upcoming IPO is a major test of investor appetite for AI, with the offering heavily oversubscribed and following SpaceX's successful debut. However, the IPO faces potential challenges due to Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia, which plans to invest in Anthropic. Huang played a key role in connecting companies driving the AI boom. (Word count: 50)

items.title: Italy Fines Meta €805 Million Over Access to Users’ Photos
items.content: The Italian Data Protection Authority fined Meta Platforms Inc. €805 million ($887 million) for accessing photos and videos of Android users’ galleries without their explicit consent.
items.contentSnippet: The Italian Data Protection Authority fined Meta Platforms Inc. €805 million ($887 million) for accessing photos and videos of Android users’ galleries without their explicit consent.
items.creator: Tiago Ramos Alfaro

summaries.zh: 意大利数据保护机构对Meta公司处以8.05亿欧元罚款，因其在未经安卓用户明确同意的情况下访问其相册中的照片和视频。
summaries.en: The Italian Data Protection Authority fined Meta Platforms €805 million ($887 million) for accessing Android users' photos and videos without their explicit consent. The authority determined that Meta violated privacy regulations by collecting the data without proper authorization.

items.title: Nvidia Looks for a New Era After Huang
items.content: Bloomberg’s Emily Chang tells Bloomberg This Weekend what her recent interview with Jensen Huang reveals about Nvidia’s succession challenge after the longtime CEO’s abrupt departure. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Chang examines who could succeed Huang, the questions surrounding Nvidia’s China strategy and whether the AI giant can preserve the influence and relationships Huang built over more than three decades. (Source: Bloomberg)

Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Chang examines who could succeed Huang, the questions surrounding Nvidia’s China strategy and whether the AI giant can preserve the influence and relationships Huang built over more than three decades. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 《Nvidia在黄仁勋离职后寻求新阶段》报道了彭博记者Emily Chang对英伟达CEO黄仁勋的采访。文章探讨黄离职后的继任挑战，分析潜在继任者人选、中国战略疑问，以及英伟达能否保持黄三十年建立的行业影响力。报道源自彭博。
summaries.en: Nvidia faces a succession challenge following CEO Jensen Huang's departure, as reported by Bloomberg's Emily Chang. The article explores potential successors, questions about Nvidia's China strategy, and concerns over maintaining the influence and relationships Huang established over three decades. The focus is on navigating this transition for the AI giant.

items.title: Couples Are Bringing AI Into Their Arguments
items.content: Bloomberg Weekend senior writer Morgan Meaker tells Bloomberg This Weekend how people are increasingly turning to AI chatbots for advice, validation and even mediation during arguments with their partners. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Meaker explores when AI can improve communication and when introducing a digital “third entity” risks creating distance between couples. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Bloomberg Weekend senior writer Morgan Meaker tells Bloomberg This Weekend how people are increasingly turning to AI chatbots for advice, validation and even mediation during arguments with their partners. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Meaker explores when AI can improve communication and when introducing a digital “third entity” risks creating distance between couples. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 《彭博周末》高级记者莫根·梅克指出，人们越来越多地利用AI聊天机器人获取建议、寻求认同甚至调解伴侣间的争吵。她探讨AI在改善沟通中的作用，以及引入数字“第三方”可能疏远伴侣的风险。
summaries.en: Couples are increasingly using AI chatbots for advice, validation, and mediation during arguments with partners, according to Bloomberg Weekend's Morgan Meaker. Meaker discusses how AI can improve communication but also risks creating distance by introducing a digital third party. The discussion explores the dual role of AI in relationships.

items.title: “Bigger Than a Business Story”: Nvidia Shakeup
items.content: At the end of a week that saw revelations of ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged affairs with employees and a suspected Chinese spy, Centerview Partners Senior Counselor Richard Haass says the national security implications go beyond the consequences for the company itself.  (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh:
文章标题：“比商业故事更大：英伟达动荡”

本周，英伟达CEO黄仁勋被曝涉及员工情事及疑似中国间谍事件。Centerview Partners高级顾问理查德·哈斯表示，其影响已超越公司本身，具有国家安全层面的意义。（消息来源：彭博社）
summaries.en: The article discusses Nvidia's recent turmoil, including allegations of CEO Jensen Huang's misconduct and a suspected Chinese spy. Centerview Partners' Richard Haass highlights that the situation has broader national security implications, extending beyond Nvidia's internal issues. The piece emphasizes the potential far-reaching consequences of the events.

items.title: Tech Giants Face More Grid Cost Pressure on Democratic Sweep
items.content: Tech giants chasing the infinite promise of AI are finding themselves increasingly on the hook for something far earthier — the electrical grid. A Democratic sweep will only intensify that.
items.contentSnippet: Tech giants chasing the infinite promise of AI are finding themselves increasingly on the hook for something far earthier — the electrical grid. A Democratic sweep will only intensify that.
items.creator: Michelle Cheng and Dawn Lim

summaries.zh: 科技巨头在追逐AI无限前景的同时，正面临日益严峻的电网成本压力。随着民主党赢得选举，这一压力将加剧。
summaries.en: Tech giants are facing rising pressure to address grid costs as they pursue AI development. A Democratic sweep is expected to exacerbate this challenge, requiring these companies to manage their energy demands more effectively.

items.title: Nvidia’s Leadership Shakeup Tests AI Chip Giant
items.content: Bloomberg senior technology and strategic industries editor Mike Shepard tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Nvidia’s appointment of longtime CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO may offer investors some stability after Jensen Huang’s abrupt departure. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Shepard examines how Nvidia moves beyond a leader who defined the company for more than three decades and whether the upheaval creates an opening for AI chip rivals. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Bloomberg senior technology and strategic industries editor Mike Shepard tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Nvidia’s appointment of longtime CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO may offer investors some stability after Jensen Huang’s abrupt departure. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Shepard examines how Nvidia moves beyond a leader who defined the company for more than three decades and whether the upheaval creates an opening for AI chip rivals. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 英伟达任命长期CFO科莱特·克雷斯为代理CEO，以应对黄仁勋突然离任带来的不确定性，旨在为投资者提供稳定预期。分析师关注此次领导层变动是否将推动英伟达超越其三十余年来的领导者形象，以及该动荡是否会为AI芯片竞争对手创造机会。
summaries.en: Nvidia's interim CEO appointment of CFO Colette Kress follows Jensen Huang's departure, potentially providing investor stability. The leadership change marks a shift after Huang's decades-long tenure, raising questions about Nvidia's future direction and whether it creates opportunities for AI chip competitors. The move aims to maintain momentum in the AI industry.

items.title: Microsoft Says Services Fully Restored After Outage Roiled World
items.content: Microsoft Corp. said access has been fully restored to its flagship software, ending an outage that paralyzed government offices, traders and businesses around the world.
items.contentSnippet: Microsoft Corp. said access has been fully restored to its flagship software, ending an outage that paralyzed government offices, traders and businesses around the world.
items.creator: Matt Day, Mark Anderson and Jo Constantz

summaries.en: Microsoft has confirmed that all access to its core services has been fully restored following a widespread outage. The disruption, which occurred earlier, significantly impacted government offices, traders, and businesses globally. The company reported that the issue has now been resolved, allowing operations to resume normally.

items.title: White House Urges Easing Liability to Encourage AI Disclosure
items.content: At a White House meeting on Thursday, officials from President Donald Trump’s artificial intelligence task force recommended that agencies ease their cyber liability policies in an effort to incentivize AI companies to report critical incidents.
items.contentSnippet: At a White House meeting on Thursday, officials from President Donald Trump’s artificial intelligence task force recommended that agencies ease their cyber liability policies in an effort to incentivize AI companies to report critical incidents.
items.creator: Maggie Eastland

summaries.zh: 白宫官员在周四会议上建议，为鼓励人工智能公司报告关键事件，各机构应放宽网络责任政策。此举旨在通过减轻企业责任，促进AI安全透明。
summaries.en: The White House's AI task force suggested easing cyber liability policies to encourage AI companies to disclose critical incidents during a meeting. This approach aims to promote transparency in the AI industry by reducing the risk associated with reporting errors or vulnerabilities.

items.title: SpaceX Starship Launches on Flight Test of Reusability
items.content: SpaceX’s Starship rocket took off from the Starbase launch facility in South Texas on a flight test to bring both sections of the vehicle safely back to Earth. Ed Ludlow reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: SpaceX’s Starship rocket took off from the Starbase launch facility in South Texas on a flight test to bring both sections of the vehicle safely back to Earth. Ed Ludlow reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: SpaceX的星舰火箭从德克萨斯州星基地发射，进行可重复使用性飞行测试。此次测试旨在验证火箭两部分的返地安全回收能力。报道来源：彭博社。
summaries.en: SpaceX's Starship rocket launched from Starbase in Texas for a reusability test, aiming to safely return both sections of the vehicle to Earth. The flight was part of a development effort to demonstrate the system's ability to be reused. The test was reported by Ed Ludlow.

items.content: Nina Trentmann, senior editor at Bloomberg News, says Colette Kress is likely to become more visible as Nvidia’s interim CEO, speaking more about the company’s finances, performance and plans after Jensen Huang’s departure. She speaks with Vonnie Quinn on “The Close”. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.content: Modine Manufacturing Co. logged its biggest single-day gain since 2020 after Bloomberg News reported the maker of cooling systems for data centers was in talks to be acquired by Samsung Electronics Co.

items.title: Morgan Stanley’s Shalett ‘Incredibly’ Bullish Despite AI Turmoil
items.content: Nvidia Corp.’s leadership turmoil and the Democrats’ midterm election victories have added to concerns about the artificial intelligence boom, but those won’t derail the main driver of the bull market: capital spending on AI infrastructure, says Morgan Stanley Wealth Management’s Lisa Shalett.
items.contentSnippet: Nvidia Corp.’s leadership turmoil and the Democrats’ midterm election victories have added to concerns about the artificial intelligence boom, but those won’t derail the main driver of the bull market: capital spending on AI infrastructure, says Morgan Stanley Wealth Management’s Lisa Shalett.
items.creator: Natalia Kniazhevich

summaries.zh: 摩根士丹利财富管理首席投资官丽莎·沙莱特表示，尽管英伟达公司领导层动荡和民主党在中期选举中获胜加剧了对人工智能繁荣的担忧，但这些因素不会动摇牛市的主要驱动力——对人工智能基础设施的资本支出。她认为市场前景依然乐观。
summaries.en: Lisa Shalett of Morgan Stanley Wealth Management remains "incredibly" bullish on the AI market, despite concerns fueled by Nvidia's leadership turmoil and Democrats' midterm election wins. She argues that these challenges won't derail the primary driver of the bull market—capital spending on AI infrastructure. The focus remains on the sustained growth potential of AI investments.

items.title: Match Group Keeping AI Out of Dating
items.content: Match Group is embracing artificial intelligence across its business, but CEO Spencer Rascoff says AI agents won't be allowed to date for users on Tinder, Hinge and its other apps. Rascoff says Match wants its platforms to remain a “human-only zone,” even as the company uses AI to verify identities, improve safety and block harmful messages. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss where companies should draw the line on AI and how the technology is transforming Match Group. He also weighs ibn on Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia and why he thinks companies are ultimately bigger than any one CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Match Group is embracing artificial intelligence across its business, but CEO Spencer Rascoff says AI agents won't be allowed to date for users on Tinder, Hinge and its other apps. Rascoff says Match wants its platforms to remain a “human-only zone,” even as the company uses AI to verify identities, improve safety and block harmful messages. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss where companies should draw the line on AI and how the technology is transforming Match Group. He also weighs ibn on Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia and why he thinks companies are ultimately bigger than any one CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: Match Group将AI技术应用于业务，但CEO Spencer Rascoff表示，其Tinder、Hinge等应用中的AI代理将不被允许为用户约会。公司希望保持平台的“人类专属”性质，同时利用AI进行身份验证、安全防护和有害信息拦截。Rascoff在Bloomberg Businessweek Daily中探讨了企业应如何界定AI应用边界，以及AI如何重塑Match Group，并评论了黄仁勋离开Nvidia的影响。
summaries.en: Match Group plans to integrate AI into its operations but will ban AI agents from dating apps like Tinder and Hinge, CEO Spencer Rascoff confirmed. While the company uses AI for identity verification, safety enhancements, and blocking harmful messages, Rascoff emphasizes maintaining a "human-only zone" for user interactions. He discussed AI's impact on Match Group and the broader tech landscape during an interview with Bloomberg Businessweek Daily.

items.title: Amazon Forced Into First North American Union Pact in Canada
items.content: Hundreds of Amazon.com Inc. warehouse employees in western Canada are the company’s first North American logistics workers to be covered by a union contract after an independent arbitrator on Friday imposed terms between the online retailer and Unifor, one of the largest private-sector unions in the nation.
items.contentSnippet: Hundreds of Amazon.com Inc. warehouse employees in western Canada are the company’s first North American logistics workers to be covered by a union contract after an independent arbitrator on Friday imposed terms between the online retailer and Unifor, one of the largest private-sector unions in the nation.
items.creator: Spencer Soper and Thomas Seal

summaries.zh: 亚马逊加拿大西部数百名仓库员工成为该公司北美物流工人中首批签订工会合同的员工。周五，一名独立仲裁员强制执行了在线零售商与加拿大最大私营部门工会之一的Unifor之间的协议。这是亚马逊在北美首次与工会达成协议。
summaries.en: Amazon and Unifor, Canada's largest private-sector union, have reached a union contract for hundreds of warehouse workers in western Canada. This marks Amazon's first unionized workforce in North America under a collective bargaining agreement. The agreement was imposed by an independent arbitrator after negotiations. The workers, employed in logistics roles, are now covered by union terms.

items.summary: 亚马逊加拿大西部数百名仓库员工成为该公司北美物流工人中首批签订工会合同的员工。周五，一名独立仲裁员强制执行了在线零售商与加拿大最大私营部门工会之一的Unifor之间的协议。这是亚马逊在北美首次与工会达成协议。

items.title: FBI Said to Probe Whether Software Update Caused Mass FAA Outage
items.content: The Federal Bureau of Investigation doesn’t believe the communication issue affecting air traffic control was due to a cyberattack or criminality, said a person familiar with the matter. One area of inquiry is whether the outage was caused by a software update, the person said.

One area of inquiry is whether the outage was caused by a software update, the person said.

summaries.zh: 据知情人士透露，联邦调查局（FBI）调查了影响空中交通控制的通信问题，认为并非网络攻击或犯罪行为所致。调查重点之一是该故障是否由软件更新引起。
summaries.en: The FBI is investigating a major FAA outage affecting air traffic control, but officials do not suspect a cyberattack or criminal activity. The investigation is focusing on whether the disruption was caused by a software update. The findings are still pending, but the FBI aims to determine the root cause of the widespread issue.

items.title: Nvidia Crisis Spurs Scrutiny of Agency That Oversees Chip Curbs
items.content: The Trump administration official who runs US export control programs was looking for marquee names for his agency’s upcoming annual conference and threw an unusual option into the mix: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang.

summaries.en: The Trump administration's export control chief sought Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang as a speaker for the agency's annual conference, marking scrutiny of the chip industry amid trade tensions. The move reflects growing attention on Nvidia amid broader discussions over US semiconductor export restrictions. The conference aimed to highlight the agency's oversight role in regulating high-tech exports.

items.title: Blackstone’s QTS Is Cutting AI Debt Sale by More Than Half
items.content: QTS, a data center operator backed by Blackstone Inc., is slashing the size of a planned private debt sale by about 60% after struggling to attract enough demand from investors — and refusing to pay much higher yields.
items.contentSnippet: QTS, a data center operator backed by Blackstone Inc., is slashing the size of a planned private debt sale by about 60% after struggling to attract enough demand from investors — and refusing to pay much higher yields.
items.creator: Menghan Xiao and Emily Graffeo

summaries.zh: 黑石旗下数据中心运营商QTS将计划中的私募债务发行规模削减约60%。由于投资者需求不足，QTS拒绝支付更高的收益率，导致此次发售面临困境。
summaries.en: QTS, a data center operator backed by Blackstone, is reducing its planned private debt sale by over 60% due to insufficient investor demand. The company has also declined to offer significantly higher yields to attract buyers. The adjustment reflects challenges in the current market conditions for the debt offering.
